Name: Utility
Description:
Utility enables economic industrial decarbonization at scale by delivering practical solutions that integrate with existing infrastructure and economics.

Utility delivers solutions that drive industrial decarbonization across hard-to-abate sectors including steel, low-carbon fuels, refining, petrochemicals, and chemicals and upstream oil and gas. Our breakthrough H2Gen technology converts water to pure hydrogen by using electrochemical energy in industrial off gases and biogenic gases to drive water electrolysis without electricity. H2Gen also concentrates carbon dioxide in off gases as a separate product stream, enabling economic industrial decarbonization.

H2Gen systems are modular, scalable, and operationally flexible, integrating seamlessly into existing industrial assets with a small footprint, making decarbonization practical and economic.

World-Class Ecosystem

Utility was created to enable true economic industrial decarbonization, bringing about the commercial transition to a low-carbon world. This is our passion, our drive, and the reason why we exist. Globally recognized, our world-class stakeholders are unparalleled.

Our team consists of top professional talent, including engineers and scientists, designers and operators, storytellers and strategists, all united by a shared belief and guided by highly experienced industry leaders.

Name: NEG8 Carbon
Description:
NEG8 Carbon develops Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology that extracts carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere with its unique Electrostatic DAC system to reverse the effects of global warming. 

The NEG8 Carbon team of specialist engineers and scientists are developing DAC tech that is efficient and affordable therefore scalable for mass deployment. 

The company originated as a spin-out from carbon capture research conducted at Trinity College Dublin and University College Dublin, and has now set up headquarters in Waterford, Ireland. 

The goal: capturing 100 million tonnes of CO2 annually by 2050 at less than €100/tonne CO2.

Name: CMT Caren Meicnic Teoranta
Description:
Caren Meicnic Teoranta (CMT) is an exciting new Irish climate tech innovator that is set to disrupt the global atmospheric water generation industry. Our generators turn the air around us into drinkable water, almost anywhere water is needed! Our breakthrough technology will bring the opportunity to positively transform lives and the environment around the world.

Our patented technology is already able to harvest hundreds of litres of water a day per unit, just from the humidity in the air around us! The Atmospheric Water Generation industry is valued at circa $3 Billion. Unlike most competitors, we achieve water sourcing without any costly and complex refrigeration technology. Our lower costs of production and lower running costs will allow us bring affordable and reliable water access to those who need it most. 

• 2+ Billion People don’t have access to safely managed water
• 703M people don’t have access to basic water at home
• 200M hours a day are spent by women and children fetching water
• >1M deaths a year are linked to water issues
• Even major cities like Mexico City, Johannesburg and Dublin all face water shortage and/or contamination issues from aging networks.

We can and will help change all this.

Currently operating in stealth mode, our upcoming launch will enable us to share more on our technology and our plans, and most importantly, ignite growth in this vital industry. Sourcing water at point of need, for all.

Name: Carbon Fintech
Description:
Carbon Fintech is a trailblazer in environmental sustainability, offering a unique solution for businesses across various sectors aiming to mitigate their climate impact and comply with the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive. Our fully integrated global system specializes in generating high-quality Biodiversity Credits, which are created locally to the buyer. This approach ensures that our credits are not only relevant and trustworthy but also contribute positively to local communities and their circular economies.

We are proud to operate the first globally scalable system capable of monitoring pre-mapped land parcels in real-time. This innovative method allows for the generation of science-based Biodiversity & Credits, which are then transparently registered on a public blockchain. This level of traceability and trustworthiness positions our credits as a reliable tool for businesses committed to fulfilling their mandatory ESG reporting obligations, while genuinely contributing to environmental preservation and community development.

Name: Olivine Technologies
Description:
At Olivine Technologies, we are at the forefront of developing innovative carbon storage solutions, specifically tailored for the spirits and ethanol sectors. 
Our cutting-edge reactor technology utilizes olivine, a naturally occurring mineral, to effectively capture and store biogenic CO2 produced during fermentation processes. This approach not only helps distilleries reduce their carbon footprint but also enhances their sustainability credentials in an increasingly climate-conscious market.

Our Approach to Carbon Storage
1. Advanced Reactor Technology:
Our primary focus is on advancing reactor technology that leverages olivine’s unique properties. Olivine reacts with CO2 to form stable carbonates, providing a permanent and environmentally friendly solution for permanent low cost carbon storage. This method is both cost-effective and efficient, making it an attractive option for distilleries looking to offset their emissions.

2. Biogenic CO2 Capture:
During the fermentation process, significant amounts of biogenic CO2 are produced. Unlike fossil fuel-derived CO2, biogenic CO2 is part of the natural carbon cycle. By capturing this CO2, our technology helps distilleries achieve negative emissions, effectively removing carbon from the atmosphere.

3. Enhancing Brand Sustainability:
Consumers and regulators are increasingly concerned about the environmental impact of the products they purchase. Our solution allows distilleries to market their products as carbon-neutral. This can provide a competitive edge in a future market characterized by heightened climate sensitivity.

4. Addressing Scope 3 Emissions:
While many distilleries have made progress in reducing Scope 1 and 2 emissions, Scope 3 emissions remain a significant challenge. Our technology provides a viable pathway for distilleries to address these indirect emissions, aligning with broader sustainability goals and commitments, such as achieving Net Zero.
